masteryZone.q: Which hybridization is present in Diamond?
masteryZone.sol: Diamond has sp³ hybridized carbon atoms forming a 3D network.

masteryZone.q: True or False: Graphite does not conduct electricity.
masteryZone.sol: False. Graphite has free valence electrons and conducts electricity well.

masteryZone.q: What is the suffix for Aldehydes?
True or False: Homologous series members differ by a -CH₂- unit.
masteryZone.sol: True. Successive members differ by a -CH₂- group and 14 u mass.

masteryZone.q: Vegetable oil is converted to ghee using which reaction?
masteryZone.sol: Hydrogenation is an addition reaction using nickel catalyst.

masteryZone.q: True or False: Soaps work effectively in hard water.
masteryZone.sol: False. Soaps form insoluble scum in hard water.
